items.heading: Daraba
details: Key ingredients: okra, meat, peanut paste, leafy greens
Simmer meat until tender in a well-seasoned broth.
Add chopped okra and leafy greens.
Stir in peanut paste to thicken the stew.
Cook until glossy and thick, then serve over rice or millet.

items.heading: Boule with Sauce
details: Key ingredients: millet flour, water, tomato, meat, onion
Whisk millet flour into boiling water, stirring until thick and smooth.
Continue cooking and stirring until it forms a firm dough (boule).
Simmer meat with tomato and onion into a hearty sauce.
Serve the boule alongside the sauce for dipping.

items.heading: Chakalaka
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
